name: Cortina Holdings Limited
summary: Cortina Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the distribution and retailing of timepieces and accessories in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Wholesale, Retail, and Unallocated segments. The Wholesale segment engages in the wholesale of timepieces and luxury branded accessories. Its Retail segment is involved in the retail of timepieces, branded pens, and accessories. The Unallocated segment provides other support services. Cortina Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Singapore.
